scripts.start: node -e "import express from 'express'; const basePort = Number(process.env.PORT || 3000); const app = express(); app.use(express.static('.')); const tryListen = (port) => { const server = app.listen(port, () => console.log('Display server running at http://localhost:' + port)); server.on('error', (err) => { if (err.code === 'EADDRINUSE') { console.warn('Port ' + port + ' is already in use. Retrying on ' + (port + 1) + '...'); server.close(); tryListen(port + 1); } else { console.error(err); process.exit(1); } }); }; tryListen(basePort);"
